Table: Components/Table -> Style Overrides: header-row cells rendered lavender #c4b5fd on the teal header bg #0f766e = 2.96:1 (< 4.5 text). Root cause: the header <TableRow> cells are plain <td> (.cell), not data-header-cell (their children are text, not <th>), so the td's own color rule (color: var(--table-cell-color)) inherits the container's lavender #c4b5fd and beats the white it would otherwise inherit from the <thead>; the Table's headerColor:#ffffff was therefore a dead override for the cell text. Fixed in src/components/Table/Table.stories.tsx by giving each of the 4 header TableCells a closer per-cell override styles={{ color: '#ffffff' }} (maps to --table-cell-color on the td), honoring the story's documented intent of white header text. Now white #ffffff on teal #0f766e = 5.47:1 (pass). Body cells unchanged: lavender #c4b5fd on navy #101830 = 9.52:1 (pass, never flagged). Updated the story's doc comment to describe the closest-wins mechanism and the contrast rationale. No component CSS/logic changed (zero regression risk to other Table stories/consumers); no play function on this story so no data/play reconciliation needed.
